title: Supervision.
officialText:
The master fire suppression piping contractor shall conduct his or her business to provide direct and
continuing supervision in accordance with the provisions of this article.
Exception: The provisions of this section 28-410.8.6 shall not apply to minor alterations or ordinary repairs, as defined in this
code, and/or to maintenance of a fire suppression piping system.
ARTICLE 411
JOURNEYMAN FIRE SUPPRESSION PIPING
INSTALLER REGISTRATION
